plan.notes: Official Concordia University Chicago 2025-2026 catalog (archive), Computer Science BS requirements. The catalog publishes official degree requirements with no official semester sequence; collected as a single requirements block. Per-course credits are published only for the four support courses (4 each) and the capstone (3); required-course and elective credit cells were blank in the catalog table and were NOT invented - recorded as official block totals (required 26 hours, electives 9 hours). Blocks sum to 51 hours; the catalog states the major is 54 hours (3 hours unaccounted in the published breakdown, disclosed here). Program total is 120 credits; general education and additional electives beyond the major are not itemized in this requirements capture.

courses.title: Required computer science courses (26 hours)
courses.choice_note: 26-hour required block; per-course credit cells were blank in the catalog table (recorded as not published, not invented). Courses: CSC-2100 Discrete Structures; CSC-2410 Computer Science I; CSC-2411 Applied Programming Techniques in Computer Science I; CSC-2510 Computer Science II; CSC-2710 Computer Organization and Architecture; CSC-3420 Data Structures and Algorithms; CSC-3421 Applied Programming Techniques in Data Structures and Algorithms; CSC-3440 Computer Networking and Communication; CSC-3460 Software Engineering I; CSC-4450 Operating Systems.

courses.title: Computer science electives (9 hours)
courses.choice_note: 9-hour elective block; per-course credits not published except capstone. Options: CSC-2620 Database Systems & Design; CSC-3210 Object-Oriented and Database Programming Practicum; CSC-3422 Data Structures with Data Science II; CSC-3424 Data Structures with Data Science III; CSC-3430 Advanced Object-Oriented Programming; CSC-3450 Website Design and Development; CSC-4430 Mobile Application Development; CSC-4460 Software Engineering II; CSC-4730 ACCA Seminar in Computer Science; CSC-4910 Topics in Computer Science; CSC-4920 Capstone in Computer Science (3) OR CSC-4991 Internship.
